outline: This is the first course in numerical analysis for graduate students. The objectives of the course include: (1) Development and applications of numerical methods when analytical techniques are not available; (2) Numerical differentiation and integration; (3) Numerical solution of ODEs and PDEs; (4) To get familiar with different types of commercial software.
schedule:
Week 1 Introduction, some useful software and python
Week 2 Interpolation
Week 3 Numerical differentiation
Week 4 Numerical differentiation
Week 5 Numerical integration
Week 6 Numerical integration
Week 7 Numerical solution of ODEs
Week 8 Numerical solution of ODEs
Week 9 Numerical solution of ODEs
Week 10 Numerical solution of PDEs
Week 11 Numerical solution of PDEs
Week 12 Numerical solution of PDEs
Week 13 Discrete element method: PFC
Week 14 Discrete element method: UDEC
Week 15 (6/15 holiday)
Week 16 Finite difference method: FLAC
Week 17 Presentation and discussion
Week 18 Project submission
